'''Korvaii''' was a small [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located in the [[Kordu sector/Legends|Kordu sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
In the aftermath of the [[New Sith Wars]], during the [[Unification Campaigns]] of the [[900s BBY]], the final battle of the [[Melusi Uprising]] took place on Korvaii. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] served gallantly during a [[Confrontation on Korvaii|confrontation]] on the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], bringing the conflict to an end.<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Korvaii was initially left relatively unharmed by the new regime and was represented in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mina Dhori Tolas|Mina Dhori]]. However, after the Senate was abrogated by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] imprisoned the planet's population in camps.
